questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake nufi da 'bakake' (consonants) a fannin ilimin sauti na Hausa?
options: Sautukan da ake fadarwa ta hanyar toshe ko taƙaita iska a wani sashe na baki
Sautukan da ke fitowa ba tare da toshewar iska ba
questions.explanation: Consonants (bakake) are speech sounds produced by obstructing or restricting the airflow at some point in the vocal tract, unlike vowels which flow freely.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake nufi da 'wasali' (vowels) a fannin ilimin sauti na Hausa?
options: Haruffan da ake amfani da su domin rubutun lambobi
Sautukan da ake fadarwa ba tare da toshewar iska ba a baki
Sautukan da ake toshe iska gaba daya
questions.explanation: Vowels (wasali) are speech sounds produced with a free, unobstructed flow of air through the vocal tract, unlike consonants.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, wasula na iya zama gajeru ko
questions.explanation: Hausa vowels are distinguished by length, being either short (gajeru) or long (dogaye), a distinction that can change a word's meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira hadewar haruffa biyu domin wakiltar sauti daya, kamar 'sh' ko 'ky', a Hausa?
questions.explanation: Digraphs (tagwayen bakake) are combinations of two letters, such as 'sh', 'ts', 'gy', 'ky', and 'kw', used to represent single distinct sounds in Hausa.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sauyin sautin murya wanda ke nuna bambanci a ma'anar kalmomi iri daya a rubuce, a Hausa?
questions.explanation: Tone (karin sauti) is the pitch pattern of a syllable, and in Hausa it can distinguish between words that are otherwise spelled identically.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wadanne irin karin sauti ne ake samu a Hausa?
questions.explanation: Hausa tone system generally recognises three tonal categories: high, low, and falling tones, which can change word meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira daidaituwar wasula a cikin kalma guda, inda wasu wasula ke shafar yadda ake furta wasu, a Hausa?
questions.explanation: Vowel harmony (cakuɗar wasali) refers to a phonological pattern where certain vowels within a word influence or agree with each other in quality.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sashin sauti wanda ke dauke da wasali guda daya ko fiye, wanda shine tubalin da ake gina kalmomi da su?
questions.explanation: A syllable (gaɓa) is a unit of sound built around a vowel, serving as the fundamental building block of spoken words.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Gaɓa mai buɗewa (open syllable) a Hausa yakan kare da
questions.explanation: An open syllable (buɗaddiya) ends in a vowel sound, unlike a closed syllable which ends in a consonant.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Gaɓa mai rufewa (closed syllable) a Hausa yakan kare da
questions.explanation: A closed syllable (rufakkiya) ends in a consonant sound, in contrast to an open syllable which ends in a vowel.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane baƙi ne ke wakiltar sautin da ake fadarwa ta hanyar toshe iska sannan a saki shi kwatsam da karfi na musamman (implosive), kamar 'ɓ'?
questions.explanation: The hooked letter Ɓ represents an implosive consonant sound, distinct in articulation from the plain (unhooked) B.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane baƙi ne ke wakiltar sautin implosive/ejective da aka rubuta da lankwasa a karkashinsa, kamar 'ɗ'?
questions.explanation: The hooked letter Ɗ represents a distinct implosive consonant sound, separate from the plain D used elsewhere in the alphabet.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane baƙi ne ke wakiltar sautin ejective da aka rubuta da lankwasa, kamar 'ƙ'?
questions.explanation: The hooked letter Ƙ represents an ejective consonant sound, distinct from the plain K in standard Hausa orthography.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sautin da ake fadarwa ta hanyar goge sassan baki tare, kamar 's' da 'z'?
questions.explanation: Fricative sounds are produced by forcing air through a narrow channel, creating friction, as with sounds like 's' and 'z'.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira sautin da ake fadarwa ta hanci, kamar 'm' da 'n'?
questions.explanation: Nasal sounds, such as 'm' and 'n', are produced with air passing through the nose rather than solely through the mouth.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A ilimin sauti, ana amfani da menene domin nazarin yadda ake fadar sauti ta bakin dan'adam?
questions.explanation: Phonetics and phonology are the branches of linguistics dedicated to studying how speech sounds are produced, transmitted, and structured within a language.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wasali dogo a rubutun Hausa ana nuna shi ta hanyar
options: amfani da baƙi biyu a jere kawai
ninka wasalin, misali 'aa' ko amfani da alamar dogewa
questions.explanation: Long vowels in Hausa are typically indicated by doubling the vowel letter or using a length mark, distinguishing them from short vowels.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Bambancin da ke tsakanin 'kudi' (money) da 'kudī' (a fadowar karin sauti misali) na iya nunawa ta hanyar
questions.explanation: In Hausa, tone differences alone can distinguish words that otherwise share the same consonant and vowel sequence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira nazarin yadda ake hada sautuka domin samar da kalmomi masu ma'ana a wani harshe?
questions.explanation: Phonology is specifically concerned with the sound system of a language, including how sounds combine to form meaningful units.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane bangare ne na ilimin sauti ke nazarin yadda ake fadar sautuka ta jiki (articulatory features)?
questions.explanation: Phonetics studies the physical production and articulation of speech sounds, complementing phonology's focus on sound patterns and systems.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane azuzuwan kalma ne ke suna wa mutum, wuri, ko abu, a Hausa?
questions.explanation: A noun (suna) is the part of speech used to name a person, place, thing, or idea.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane azuzuwan kalma ne ke maye gurbin suna a cikin jimla, kamar 'shi', 'ita', 'su'?
questions.explanation: A pronoun (wakilin suna) stands in place of a noun, such as 'he/him' (shi), 'she/her' (ita), or 'they/them' (su).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane azuzuwan kalma ne ke nuna aiki ko yanayi a jimla, kamar 'tafi', 'ci', 'zauna'?
questions.explanation: A verb (aikatau) expresses an action, occurrence, or state, forming the core of the predicate in a sentence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane azuzuwan kalma ne ke bayyana siffar suna, kamar 'mai kyau', 'baki', 'babba'?
questions.explanation: An adjective (sifa) describes or modifies a noun, giving more information about its quality or characteristics.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane azuzuwan kalma ne ke hada suna ko wakilin suna zuwa wani sashe na jimla, kamar 'a', 'da', 'kan'?
questions.explanation: A preposition (bami) links a noun or pronoun to another part of the sentence, showing relationships such as location, direction, or time.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane azuzuwan kalma ne ke hada kalmomi ko jimloli biyu tare, kamar 'da', 'amma', 'ko'?
questions.explanation: A conjunction (gami) joins words, phrases, or clauses together, such as 'and' (da), 'but' (amma), or 'or' (ko).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, jinsin suna (gender) yakan kasu zuwa
questions.explanation: In Hausa grammar, noun gender is generally classified as masculine (namiji) or feminine (mace).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A Hausa, adadin suna (number) yakan kasu zuwa
questions.explanation: Number in Hausa nouns is classified as singular (tilas), referring to one, or plural (jam'i), referring to more than one.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake nufi da 'shashen lokaci' (tense/aspect) na aikatau a Hausa?
options: Yadda ake nuna lokacin da aikin ya faru, ko na yau da kullum ne, ko na baya, ko na gaba
questions.explanation: Tense/aspect marking on Hausa verbs indicates the timing and nature of an action, such as whether it is completed, ongoing, habitual, or yet to occur.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace jimla ce ake kira 'sauƙaƙƙiyar jimla' (simple sentence) a Hausa?
options: Jimlar da ke da ma'ana daya kacal, mai fannin suna da aikatau guda daya
Jimlar da ke da fannoni biyu ko fiye hade tare
Jimlar da ke da tambaya kawai
Jimlar da ba ta da ma'ana
questions.explanation: A simple sentence (sauƙaƙƙiyar jimla) expresses a single complete thought, typically containing one subject and one main verb.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace jimla ce ake kira 'sarƙaƙƙiyar jimla' (complex sentence) a Hausa?
options: Jimlar da ke da kalma guda daya kacal
Jimlar da ba ta da fi'ili
Jimlar da ke da fannoni biyu ko fiye da suka hade don kammala ma'ana daya
questions.explanation: A complex sentence (sarƙaƙƙiyar jimla) combines two or more clauses, often joined by a conjunction, to express a more elaborate idea.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira aikin nazarin sassan jimla, kamar suna, aikatau, da sifa, domin fahimtar tsarinta?
questions.explanation: Parsing (ja jimloli) involves breaking down a sentence into its grammatical components to analyse its structure and function.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene manufar 'fassarar magana' (translation) tsakanin Hausa da Turanci a fannin karatun harshe?
options: Rubuta jimla iri daya sau biyu a harshe guda
Mayar da ma'anar jimla daga harshe daya zuwa wani, tare da adana ma'ana da kalmomin salo (karin magana)
questions.explanation: Translation requires conveying the accurate meaning of a passage from one language to another, while preserving idiomatic expressions and context.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane bangare ne na nahawu ke nazarin yadda ake gina kalmomi daga tushensu da karin kalmomi (morphemes)?
questions.explanation: Morphology is the branch of grammar concerned with the internal structure of words, including roots, prefixes, and suffixes.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane bangare ne na nahawu ke nazarin yadda ake tsara kalmomi domin gina jimloli masu ma'ana?
questions.explanation: Syntax is the branch of grammar dealing with sentence structure, including how words are arranged to form grammatically correct sentences.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A jimlar Hausa, wane bangare ne ke bayyana wanda/menene jimlar take magana a kai (misali 'Musa')?
questions.explanation: The subject of a sentence identifies who or what the sentence is primarily about.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A jimlar Hausa, wane bangare ne ke bayyana abinda ake fada game da suna/fannin suna?
questions.explanation: The predicate provides information about the subject, typically including the verb and any related objects or complements.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira karin magana da ake amfani da su domin isar da sako ta hanyar kwatanci ko dabara, wanda galibi ba za a iya fassara su kalma-da-kalma ba?
questions.explanation: Karin magana refers to idiomatic or figurative expressions whose meaning often cannot be understood from a literal, word-for-word translation.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace kalma ce ta fi dacewa a matsayin 'aikatau' (verb) daga cikin wadannan?
questions.explanation: 'Karanta' (to read) expresses an action, making it a verb, unlike 'littafi' (book, a noun), 'fari' (white, an adjective), or 'da' (and/with, a conjunction/preposition).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace kalma ce ta fi dacewa a matsayin 'suna' (noun) daga cikin wadannan?
questions.explanation: 'Makaranta' (school) names a place, making it a noun, unlike 'tafi' (go, a verb), 'babba' (big, an adjective), or 'ko' (or, a conjunction).

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tsarin jinsi na Hausa, kalmar 'yarinya' tana wakiltar jinsin
questions.explanation: 'Yarinya' (girl) refers to a female, placing it within the feminine gender category in Hausa noun classification.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tsarin adadi na Hausa, kalmar 'yara' (jam'i na 'yaro') tana nuna
questions.explanation: 'Yara' is the plural form of 'yaro' (child/boy), indicating more than one, unlike the singular 'tilas' form.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira kalmar da ke nuna inda ake ko lokacin da wani abu ya faru, misali 'nan', 'can', 'yau'?
options: Bami/madogara na wuri ko lokaci (adverbial-type words)
questions.explanation: Words indicating place or time, such as 'nan' (here), 'can' (there), or 'yau' (today), function to locate an action in space or time within a sentence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira karin kalma da ake dorawa a gaban tushen kalma domin canza ma'anarta, a fannin kirar kalma?
questions.explanation: A prefix is a morpheme attached to the beginning of a word's root, modifying or extending its meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira karin kalma da ake dorawa a bayan tushen kalma domin canza ma'anarta ko aikinta a jimla?
questions.explanation: A suffix is a morpheme attached to the end of a word's root, often changing its grammatical function or meaning.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace irin rubutu ake kira 'insha'i' a fannin rubutun Hausa?
options: Rubutun kirkire-kirkire, kamar wasika, muhawara, labari, ko bayani
questions.explanation: Insha'i refers to creative or composition writing, encompassing letters, argumentative essays, narratives, and descriptive pieces.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace irin wasika ce ake kira 'wasikar aiki' (formal letter)?
options: Wasikar da ba ta da adireshi
Wasikar da ba a rubuta ta ba
Wasikar da ake rubutawa zuwa ga hukuma ko wata sana'a, cikin tsari na yau da kullum
Wasikar da ake rubutawa ga aboki na kusa cikin salon zumunci
questions.explanation: A formal letter (wasikar aiki) is written to an official, institution, or business, following a structured, professional format.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace irin wasika ce ake kira wasika ta zumunci (informal letter)?
options: Wasikar da ake rubutawa ga aboki ko dan uwa cikin salon sada zumunci
questions.explanation: An informal letter is written to a friend or family member in a warm, familiar tone, distinct from the professional style of a formal letter.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira rubutun da ake gabatar da hujjoji domin kare wani ra'ayi, wanda galibi ake kira 'muhawara'?
questions.explanation: An argumentative essay (muhawara) presents reasoned arguments to support or oppose a particular viewpoint on a topic.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira rubutun da ke ba da labarin abin da ya faru, tare da tsari na farko, tsakiya, da karshe?
questions.explanation: A narrative essay (labari) tells a story of events, typically organised with a beginning, middle, and end.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira rubutun da ke bayyana wani abu, wuri, ko mutum ta hanyar amfani da cikakkun bayanai masu ban sha'awa?
questions.explanation: A descriptive essay (bayani) uses vivid, detailed language to portray a person, place, or object clearly to the reader.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Yawan kalmomin da ake bukata a mafi karanci wajen rubutun insha'i na WAEC shine kusan
questions.explanation: WAEC composition essays are typically expected to be at least around 300 words to adequately develop the topic.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutun Hausa, ka'idojin rubutu (ka'idojin rubutun Hausa) sun hada da
options: daidaiton haruffa, rabon kalmomi, da alamomin rubutu
questions.explanation: Standard Hausa orthography rules cover correct letter usage, proper word division, and appropriate punctuation.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira aikin fahimtar rubutu domin cire manyan bayanai daga wani sashe na labari?
questions.explanation: Comprehension (auna fahimta) involves reading a passage carefully to extract main points, ideas, and important details.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A auna fahimta, menene ake nufi da 'ma'anar kalmomi bisa yanayin magana' (contextual vocabulary)?
options: Fahimtar ma'anar kalma bisa yadda aka yi amfani da ita a cikin jimla ko sakin layi
Nemo kalmar a kamus kawai ba tare da la'akari da rubutun ba
Fassara kalma zuwa Turanci kai tsaye kawai
questions.explanation: Contextual vocabulary understanding requires interpreting a word's meaning based on how it is used within its surrounding sentence or passage, rather than a fixed dictionary definition alone.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira amfani da kalmomi ko jimloli masu ma'ana wadda ba ta zahiri ba, don kwatanci ko ban mamaki, a cikin rubutu?
questions.explanation: Figurative usage involves using words or expressions beyond their literal meaning, often for comparison, emphasis, or artistic effect.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene mataki na farko da ya kamata dalibi ya dauka kafin ya fara rubuta insha'i?
options: Rubuta kai tsaye ba tare da tsari ba
Tsara tunani da fahimtar batun da za a rubuta a kai
questions.explanation: Before writing an essay, it is advisable to plan and organise one's thoughts, ensuring a clear understanding of the topic and structure to be followed.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubuta wasikar aiki, menene ya kamata a rubuta a farkon wasikar, kafin sunan mai karba?
options: Adireshin marubuci da ranar da aka rubuta wasikar
questions.explanation: A formal letter conventionally begins with the sender's address and the date, before proceeding to the recipient's details and the letter's body.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutun labari, menene ake kira sashen da ke kawo karshen labarin, inda ake warware matsalar da aka gabatar?
questions.explanation: The conclusion (kammalawa) of a narrative resolves the central conflict or situation established earlier in the story.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A rubutun muhawara, menene ya kamata marubuci ya yi domin karfafa ra'ayinsa?
options: Rubuta jimloli marasa alaka da batun
Bayar da dalilai da misalai masu goyon bayan ra'ayinsa
Yin watsi da duk wata shaida
questions.explanation: An effective argumentative essay presents clear reasons and relevant examples to support and strengthen the writer's position on a topic.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira nazarin da ake yi domin gano manufar marubuci a cikin wani rubutu?
questions.explanation: Analysing the author's intention involves considering the purpose behind the text and the message the writer aims to convey.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A auna fahimta, menene ake nufi da 'taken labari' (title/main idea)?
options: Adadin kalmomin da ke cikin rubutun
Babbar manufa ko batun da rubutun ya fi mayar da hankali a kai
questions.explanation: The main idea or theme of a passage represents its central focus, the primary point the text seeks to communicate to the reader.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ya kamata dalibi ya yi bayan kammala rubuta insha'i, kafin ya mika shi?
options: Sake dubawa domin gyara kurakuran nahawu da rubutu
Mika shi nan take ba tare da bitar sa ba
questions.explanation: Reviewing one's work before submission helps identify and correct grammatical errors, spelling mistakes, and improve overall clarity.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A wasikar zumunci, wace kalma ce ta fi dacewa a matsayin gaisuwar bude wasika ga aboki?
options: Sannu da zuwa/Yaya kake, aboki na?
Da fatan za a amsa mana nan da nan
questions.explanation: Informal letters to friends typically open with warm, familiar greetings, distinct from the formal openings used in official correspondence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira jerin kalmomin da ke bayyana yadda abubuwa suka faru bisa tsari, misali 'da farko', 'sannan', 'a karshe'?
questions.explanation: Connecting words like 'da farko' (first), 'sannan' (then), and 'a karshe' (finally) help organise ideas in a clear, logical sequence within a composition.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira bikin da ake yi domin bayar da suna ga jariri a al'adar Hausawa?
questions.explanation: The naming ceremony (suna) is a traditional Hausa rite performed to formally give a name to a newborn baby, typically on the seventh day.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausawa, menene 'aure' ke nunawa?
options: Tsarin neman aure da bikin aure tsakanin namiji da mace
Bikin bayar da suna ga jariri
questions.explanation: Aure refers to the traditional Hausa marriage process, including courtship customs and the wedding ceremony itself.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausawa, 'jana'iza' na nufin
options: Al'adun da ake bi wajen jibin da binne matacce
questions.explanation: Jana'iza refers to the traditional customs surrounding death, mourning, and burial in Hausa society.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace sana'a ce ake kira 'kira' a al'adar gargajiyar Hausawa?
questions.explanation: Kira refers to the traditional occupation of blacksmithing, working and shaping metal into tools and implements.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace sana'a ce ake kira 'saka' a al'adar gargajiyar Hausawa?
questions.explanation: Saka refers to the traditional craft of weaving cloth or fabric, an important occupation in Hausa society.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace sana'a ce ake kira 'jima' a al'adar gargajiyar Hausawa?
questions.explanation: Jima refers to the traditional craft of tanning and processing leather from animal hides.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace sana'a ce ake kira 'noma' a al'adar gargajiyar Hausawa?
questions.explanation: Noma refers to farming, one of the most fundamental and widespread traditional occupations in Hausa society.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tsarin gudanarwar gargajiyar Hausawa, wane matsayi ne ke jagorantar wata masarauta (emirate)?
questions.explanation: The Sarki (Emir) is the paramount traditional ruler at the head of a Hausa emirate's political and administrative structure.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane wasa ne na gargajiya wanda ake yi da ƙarfin hannu, tsakanin mayaka biyu, kama da dambe?
questions.explanation: Dambe is a traditional Hausa combat sport similar to boxing, involving fighters using their fists.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane wasa ne na gargajiya wanda ake yi ta hanyar kokawa da juna har daya ya fadi kasa?
questions.explanation: Kokawa is a traditional wrestling sport where opponents grapple until one is thrown to the ground.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane bikin gargajiya ne ake yi domin nuna kwarjini da jarumtaka ta hanyar musanya dukan sanda tsakanin samari?
questions.explanation: Sharo (or Shadi) is a traditional Fulani/Hausa endurance ritual in which young men are whipped to demonstrate courage and manliness.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane biki ne ake kira 'hawan kaho' a al'adar gargajiyar Hausawa?
options: Bikin gargajiya na sarauta da ake yi da kayan kade-kade na musamman
questions.explanation: Hawan kaho refers to a traditional ceremonial event, often associated with royal celebrations and accompanied by distinctive horn instruments and drumming.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace bukukuwa ce ake yi bayan azumin watan Ramadan a al'adar Hausawa musulmi?
questions.explanation: Sallah festivals, marking the end of Ramadan (Eid al-Fitr) and the pilgrimage season (Eid al-Adha), are major religious and cultural celebrations among Hausa Muslims.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban dalilin koyar da al'adun Hausawa a matsayin wani bangare na fannin karatun harshen Hausa?
options: Domin dalibai su fahimci al'adu da zamantakewar al'ummar Hausawa tare da harshensu
Domin dalibai su manta da al'adunsu
Domin koyar da wani harshe daban
questions.explanation: Studying culture alongside language helps students understand the social practices, customs, and worldview of the Hausa people, deepening their linguistic competence.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wane matsayi ne ke taimaka wa Sarki wajen shawarwari da gudanar da harkokin masarauta a tsarin sarautar gargajiya?
questions.explanation: The Fadawa (palace title-holders and advisers) traditionally assist the Sarki in governance, decision-making, and administration of the emirate.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar Hausawa, menene babban dalilin gudanar da bikin suna a rana ta bakwai bayan haihuwa?
options: Domin fara koyar da jariri karatu
Domin nishadantar da baki kadai ba tare da wata manufa ba
Domin bayar wa jariri suna a hukumance a gaban dangi da al'umma
questions.explanation: The seventh-day naming ceremony formally introduces the child's name to family and community, marking an important social and religious milestone.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A tsarin neman aure na gargajiya, wane mataki ne ake yi kafin bikin aure, inda iyalan namiji ke gabatar da bukatarsu ga iyalan mace?
questions.explanation: Before the wedding itself, traditional courtship involves the groom's family formally presenting their intention to the bride's family, a key step in Hausa marriage customs.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban rawar da sarakunan gargajiya (kamar Sarki/Emir) ke takawa a zamantakewar al'ummar Hausawa a yau?
options: Su na taimakawa wajen warware husuma da kula da al'adu, tare da hadin gwiwa da gwamnati
Su ne kadai ke da ikon kula da tsaron kasa
Su ne kadai ke da ikon yin doka a kasa
Ba su da wata rawa a yau
questions.explanation: Traditional rulers today largely assist in dispute resolution and cultural preservation, working alongside the modern government structure rather than holding sole legal authority.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A al'adar gargajiyar Hausawa, menene ake kira lokacin da ake yin sujada da nuna biyayya ga babba, musamman iyaye?
options: Ibada/Biyayya ga iyaye (respect and deference to elders)
questions.explanation: Showing deep respect and deference toward elders, especially parents, is a deeply embedded value in Hausa culture and social conduct.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene babban dalilin gudanar da bukukuwan gargajiya, kamar hawan kaho da sharo, a al'ummar Hausawa?
options: Domin nuna hadin kai, jarumtaka, da kiyaye al'adun gargajiya
questions.explanation: Traditional festivals and rites serve to demonstrate communal unity, bravery, and the preservation of cultural heritage across generations.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira adabin da ake gadarwa ta baki daga tsara zuwa tsara, kamar tatsuniya da karin magana?
questions.explanation: Oral literature (adabin baka) refers to traditional literary forms passed down verbally through generations, without being originally written down.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira labaran gargajiya masu dauke da darasi ko nishadi, wadanda galibi ake bayarwa da dare?
questions.explanation: Tatsuniya refers to traditional folktales, often told at night, that entertain while conveying moral lessons.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira wakokin baka na tarihi ko na bukukuwa a al'adar Hausawa?
questions.explanation: Oral poetry (wakokin baka) includes historical and ceremonial verse traditionally performed aloud rather than written.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira gajerun jimloli masu dauke da hikima da darasi, wadanda ake amfani da su domin isar da sako a takaice?
questions.explanation: Proverbs (karin magana) are short, wise sayings used to convey deep meaning or moral lessons in a concise, memorable form.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira wasannin baka masu kunshe da tambayoyi masu wuyar warwarewa, wadanda ake yi domin nishadi ko horar da hankali?
questions.explanation: Riddles (kacici-kacici) are traditional oral games involving puzzling questions, often used to entertain and sharpen the mind.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira adabin da aka rubuta a takarda, kamar litattafai da wasannin kwaikwayo?
questions.explanation: Written literature (rubutaccen adabi) refers to literary works recorded in written form, such as novels and plays, unlike orally transmitted literature.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira littafi mai dauke da labari mai tsawo, cikin rubutacciyar sigar zube?
questions.explanation: A novel (zubaccen rubutu) is an extended prose narrative, one of the major forms of written Hausa literature studied in schools.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira rubutun da aka tsara domin yin wasan kwaikwayo a kan dandali ko fim?
questions.explanation: A play (wasan kwaikwayo) is a written script intended for dramatic performance on stage or screen.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Menene ake kira tarin wakoki masu rubutacciyar sigar, sabanin wakokin baka?
questions.explanation: Rubutacciyar waka refers to modern written poetry, composed and recorded in text form, distinct from orally performed traditional poetry.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace dabara ake amfani da ita wajen nazarin littafin adabi domin fahimtar jigo, hali, da salon marubuci?
questions.explanation: Literary analysis involves closely examining a text's themes, characters, and the author's stylistic choices to deepen understanding of the work.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A nazarin adabi, menene ake kira babbar manufa ko sako da marubuci ke isarwa a cikin littafi?
questions.explanation: The theme (jigo) of a literary work is the central message or idea that the author conveys throughout the text.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A nazarin adabi, menene ake kira yanayin mutumin da ke cikin labari, tare da halayensa da rawar da yake takawa?
questions.explanation: A character (hali/jarumi) is a person portrayed within a literary work, defined by their traits, actions, and role in the story.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A nazarin adabi, menene ake kira wurin da ko lokacin da al'amuran labari suka faru?
questions.explanation: Setting refers to the time and place in which a story's events unfold, shaping the context of the characters' experiences.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: A nazarin adabi, menene ake kira salon musamman da marubuci ke amfani da shi wajen zabar kalmomi da tsara jimloli?
questions.explanation: Style (salo) refers to an author's distinctive manner of using language, word choice, and sentence construction throughout their work.

questions.subject: Hausa
questions.text: Wace irin adabi ce ake kira 'wakokin Islama' wadanda ke dauke da darussan addini a al'adar Hausawa?
questions.explanation: Religious poetry, often composed by Islamic scholars, conveys moral and spiritual teachings and forms an important part of Hausa literary tradition.
